name: TSH (thyroid stimulating hormone)
description: TSH is a hormone from the pituitary gland in the brain. It tells the thyroid how much thyroid hormone to make.
reasonsHigh: The thyroid making less hormone than the body needs
reasonsLow: The thyroid making more hormone than the body needs
questions: What does my TSH tell you about my thyroid?
Should we check my free T4 as well?
